description:
Centuries of existence have refined your physiology into an engine of supernatural restoration.  Stored blood directly mends your tissue and bones:
• <color_light_green>Tier 1 - High Blood (over 1800 mL):</color> Rapid mending (+6 HP / 5s); lacerations seal in ~30s (-1 bleed / 5s). Burns 4 mL blood/tick.
• <color_yellow>Tier 2 - Moderate Blood (850 to 1800 mL):</color> Steady restoration every 15s (+4 HP, -1 bleed). Burns 3 mL blood/tick.
• <color_light_red>Tier 3 - Low Blood (300 to 850 mL):</color> Slow mending every 30s (+3 HP, -1 bleed). Burns 2 mL blood/tick.
• <color_red>Tier 4 - Starving Blood (under 300 mL):</color> Minimal restoration every 60s (+1 HP). Burns 1 mL blood/tick.
• <color_red>Empty (0 mL or less):</color> Regeneration ceases completely until blood is drunk.  As an immortal Elder Progenitor, you are completely immune to dying from blood starvation or withering; your body only grows weak until you feed.
• <color_red>Sunlight Vulnerability:</color> Standing outdoors in daylight without a daylight ring scorches your flesh with agonizing heat and completely negates all regeneration.

• <color_cyan>Sanguine Surge:</color> Consuming blood from any source diminishes active bleeding wounds (-15 bleed burst) and grants a single 10s healing surge (+1 HP/s, 10s strict cooldown).

Your deadened nerves and ancient vampiric constitution suppress incoming pain by 75% and almost eliminate physical stat penalties from wounds (suppressed if wood is lodged in your flesh), and prevent falls from any height from killing you (though the impact still damages and fractures your limbs as normal).

descriptions.text: You hear a strong, rhythmic human heartbeat and smell warm arterial blood pulsing through veins here.
You sense a creature's movement and smell blood through the darkness and walls here.

description: Your veins pulse with concentrated Elder Progenitor blood.  Your deadened undead constitution grants you supreme resilience, immunity to pain penalties, high blunt and cutting absorption, and rapid movement speed.

Hardened by countless lethal hunts against the creatures of the night, this master hunter possesses unbreakable willpower, peak physical conditioning, master Krav Maga combat training, and a bloodstream saturated with mountain vervain.  Completely immune to supernatural terror, panic, and vampiric fear.
